exclusion_reason.message: Shipping candidate carried as a measurable comparison entry. The OFX default selection is a P25-7 ranking outcome and is not asserted by this input file, so the candidate is declared status=excluded here (measurement_status=measurable). The license surface below is the reviewed 2026-08-23 audit from models/sea-raft-m.json, carried as evidence, not as a shipping authorization.

WAFT/Twins is a shipping-candidate carried for measurement only. The selected zero-shot.pth checkpoint member has no published file-level commercial-use or redistribution terms (models/waft-twins-artifact.json), so shipping and OFX selection remain blocked pending an explicit checkpoint terms review. The Linux ONNX artifact identity fields carry PENDING_ONBOX_VALIDATION_waft-twins placeholders: the export/validation run has not yet produced a linux-x86_64 manifest, so these MUST be replaced with the operator's on-box validated manifest hashes before the matrix can execute any waft-twins cell. models/export_waft.py currently exposes only CPUExecutionProvider, so measurement_providers is [cpu]; CUDA measurement requires the on-box validation to establish and list it.

NeuFlow v2 is a shipping-candidate carried for measurement only, and is restricted by the frozen protocol candidate_constraints to cap mp0_331776 (768x432, canonical 16:9) on cpu/cuda. The neuflow_mixed.pth checkpoint has no checkpoint-specific license (models/neuflow-v2.json), so shipping and OFX selection remain blocked pending a checkpoint terms review. The Linux ONNX artifact identity fields carry PENDING_ONBOX_VALIDATION_neuflow-v2 placeholders: the export/validation run has not yet produced a linux-x86_64 manifest, so these MUST be replaced with the operator's on-box validated manifest hashes before the matrix can execute any neuflow-v2 cell.

Original RAFT is a validation-baseline only. The frozen P25 protocol admits it purely as a validation baseline: it can never receive an OFX choice, ship, or win the ranking, and its official checkpoint has no published commercial-use or redistribution terms (models/raft-original.json). It is CPU-only here; CUDA would require an explicit EL8 requalification not claimed by its manifest. Its Linux ONNX is CI-fetched and reproducibly exported (models/fetch_raft_checkpoint.py), so the identity fields use the materialize-from-linux-manifest CI pattern.
